lab_prompts <- c(

## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## Chronological split
```{r split-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=10}
library(fpp3)
train <- aus_production |> filter_index(. ~ "2010 Q4")
fit <- train |> model(snaive = SNAIVE(Beer), ets = ETS(Beer))
fc <- fit |> forecast(h = 8)
fc |> accuracy(aus_production)
# Try another origin, e.g. "2009 Q4", and compare rankings.
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("Chronological: train earlier, test later", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Random rows shuffled like i.i.d. ML"),
  answer("Test only the oldest observations"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("Accuracy comparisons are sensitive; check more origins / TS CV", correct = TRUE),
  answer("One origin is always definitive forever"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "Deliverables: … Methods: …",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

## Submit

Answer the questions above first, type your name, download the `.txt`, and upload it.

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}

```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = learnr::get_tutorial_state(),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
